name: Isolated Pseudoarthrosis of the Limbs
aliases: Nonunion of Long Bone in Limb

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Radiological Criteria for Isolated Pseudoarthrosis

criteria.description: Presence of congenital nonunion or failure of bone healing in a long bone of the limb
Radiographic evidence of cystic and sclerotic changes at the pseudoarthrosis site
No clinical or genetic evidence of neurofibromatosis type 1
Progressive limb deformity and localized swelling at the affected site

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of congenital nonunion confirmed by radiographic findings with exclusion of neurofibromatosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of associated syndromes such as neurofibromatosis type 1.

searchTerms: bone that never healed properly from birth

pathognomonic.symptomName: Radiographic cystic and sclerotic bone changes at pseudoarthrosis site
searchTerms: bone X-ray shows cysts and hardening at false joint
mixed bone lesions at pseudoarthrosis site
radiographic bone changes with cystic and sclerotic areas

pathognomonic.symptomName: Progressive limb deformity localized to affected bone
searchTerms: worsening limb deformity in affected bone
bump or lump at pseudoarthrosis site
bones breaking easily in affected area

common.symptomName: Pain on weight bearing or movement
searchTerms: pain when standing or moving limb
reduced joint movement close to pseudoarthrosis

occasional.symptomName: Delayed motor milestones due to limb dysfunction
searchTerms: delayed walking or motor skills due to limb issues
slow motor development from limb problems
late motor milestones caused by limb dysfunction

occasional.symptomName: Mild limb deformity in contralateral limb
searchTerms: minor limb shape changes on other side
reduced blood flow or nerve problems beyond pseudoarthrosis
neurovascular issues distal to bone defect
circulation or nerve compromise in limb
open skin wounds at bone site

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; absence of inflammatory markers unless secondary infection present
imaging: X-ray showing cystic and sclerotic changes with bone discontinuity
MRI to assess soft tissue and exclude associated neurofibromatosis
Bone scintigraphy showing decreased uptake at pseudoarthrosis site
genetic: No pathogenic variants in NF1 gene (to exclude neurofibromatosis type 1)
Genetic testing may be negative or inconclusive in isolated cases
other: Clinical exclusion of neurofibromatosis type 1 by dermatological and ophthalmological examination

distinguishingFeatures: Multiple skeletal anomalies beyond isolated pseudoarthrosis

redFlags: Signs of neurovascular compromise distal to lesion
Secondary infection or skin ulceration over pseudoarthrosis site
